about: dev2 · The Doctor at Brennock (Brennock shelf). Containers and what they hold: a town and its river in one sentence; a house and the surgery and waiting room in it; a hall and the gallery upstairs; a car by make and by model. People by title, epithet and first name (Dr Haddon, the doctor, the Old Man, Arthur; the vicar). Cities, a month and a weekday in passing. Ch 2 holds a car-colour slip, a building's material slip and a misspelt town; decoys agree. Written by the builder for round 2.

decoys.sentence: By noon the Sare was over the meadows and into the mill yard, brown and fast, carrying fence posts.
His half-moon spectacles were spotted with rain.
Constance Haddon ran it all from a trestle table, tall and fair and furious.
They slept in the Long Gallery under the aldermen, and someone lit a fire in the grate.
